schema.policy_proposal.rule_ids_and_dps_: Rules and decision points this touches
Rule ids like SCOPE-1 and decision points like DP-PRIVACY.
schema.policy_proposal.change_summary.he: Say what will be different after this change.
schema.policy_proposal.reason.label: Why this change
schema.policy_proposal.reason.help: Give the facts first. Mark anything you are assuming.
schema.policy_proposal.motivating_exampl: Masked links to audit or appeal findings. Never paste the original text.
schema.policy_proposal.expected_flips.he: Describe the kinds of past decisions that would come out differently.
schema.policy_proposal.protected_core_ch: Appeal rights and other protected rules stay as they are.
I checked that this does not change a protected rule
Protected rules cannot be changed by a proposal.
If yes, the proposal is refused and the reason is shown to you.
schema.policy_proposal.rollback_plan.hel: What would you do if it goes wrong?
schema.policy_proposal.who_is_affected.h: Say who sees a difference. Groups and roles, never named people.
schema.policy_proposal.lawful_basis.labe: Which law or rule supports this
schema.policy_proposal.lawful_basis.help: Name the law or rule. If unsure, say so.
schema.policy_proposal.risks.label: What could go wrong
schema.policy_proposal.uncertainties.hel: Things you do not know yet.
